result.title: COMPASS: Membership Inference Attack Against Vision Large Language Models via Adaptive Noise Calibration
result.summary: Vision large language models (VLLMs) are deployed in privacy-sensitive domains, raising training-data exposure concerns. Existing gray-box membership inference attacks (MIAs) commonly rely on entropy statistics or generated descriptions, requiring costly generation with limited membership separation. Perturbation-based methods instead measure response changes but focus on large perturbations, leaving VLLM membership behavior under smaller perturbations poorly understood. We systematically characterize VLLM membership behavior under controlled Gaussian perturbations across noise levels at fine resolution. We find that optimal perturbation magnitude and membership-signal direction vary across model-dataset pairs. In many settings, a previously unstudied low-noise regime yields stronger separation than large perturbations, with members exhibiting lower divergence than non-members, reversing the conventional score direction. Other settings retain the conventional direction, demonstrating that neither a fixed perturbation magnitude nor a predetermined score orientation is universally reliable. We propose COMPASS, an adaptive gray-box MIA that calibrates both the perturbation magnitude and membership-score direction using a loosely distribution-matched, known non-member reference set. We instantiate COMPASS using Renyi-normalized KL divergence and Renyi divergence, with max-k aggregation over the most informative image-logit positions. Across LLaVA v1.5-7B, MiniGPT-4, and HuluMed-32B, spanning pretraining, instruction-tuning, and medical-image datasets, COMPASS outperforms baselines. On general-domain data, COMPASS achieves AUCs up to 0.88. On the distribution-matched medical evaluation, it reaches 0.64 AUC, while the strongest baseline remains at chance level. These results establish full-range adaptive perturbation analysis as an effective approach to VLLM membership inference.

AI.brief_summary: 该文系统刻画 VLLM 在不同强度高斯图像扰动下的成员/非成员响应分歧，发现最优扰动幅度与成员信号方向随模型-数据集而变，并提出自适应校准扰动强度与分数方向的灰盒成员推断方法 COMPASS（基于 Renyi 归一化 KL 与 max-k 聚合）。
AI.relevance_reason: 把图像扰动引起的响应与图像-logit 分歧当作探针，与 LVR 中「答案是否真正依赖视觉证据」「latent 是否保留视觉细节」的诊断思路可能有方法上的相通；其「低噪声区间分离更强、分数方向会反转、不宜固定扰动强度」的结论，可供核查扰动式视觉旁路或视觉贡献度量实验的强度设定与方向假设。
